content.summary: Work items generated from commit plan

work_items.title: Emit tool-result on tool_use_summary without summary
acceptance_criteria: When tool_use_summary arrives without summary and without error, processSDKMessage emits tool-result with default output text and deletes the tool entry from state.toolCalls.
When tool_use_summary includes summary, tool-result output uses that summary (no regression from current behavior).
Tool result output includes normalized toolName and carries input from the registered tool call when available.

work_items.title: Emit tool-error on tool_use_summary failures
acceptance_criteria: When tool_use_summary indicates an error (is_error true or error field present), processSDKMessage emits tool-error with a human-readable message and removes the tool from state.toolCalls.
Error cases do not emit tool-result for the same tool id.
Tool error event includes toolName and input when available.
